name: Amsterdam
title: Ultrasonic Thickness Measurement Amsterdam & IJmuiden
description: Ultrasonic thickness measurement in Amsterdam and IJmuiden: hull structure and cargo tank UTM for product tankers and bulk carriers, plus pre-docking surveys.
h1: Ultrasonic Thickness Measurement for Ships in Amsterdam and IJmuiden
intro: Every ship bound for the Amsterdam basins passes the IJmuiden locks and then the North Sea Canal, and many of them stay for days: product tankers loading blended gasoline in Westpoort, bulk carriers at the steelworks harbour on the canal mouth, and offshore vessels between campaigns. That stay is the window superintendents use for thickness measurement in Amsterdam. Our team is mobilised from India for each job and travels to the vessel at whichever terminal, quay or repair dock she is using.

highlights.p: Westpoort's tank terminals load MR and LR product tankers for export. Deck piping, manifold and ballast tank gauging fits between parcels, and cargo tanks can be added whenever a cleaning and gas-free period is planned.

Bulk carrier gauging at IJmuiden is best timed after discharge at the steelworks harbour, before the ship ballasts out. Grab damage and hold-frame wastage from ore and coal cargoes show up clearly in empty, swept holds.

IJmuiden and the Amsterdam basins host offshore support and survey vessels between contracts. Idle periods suit thorough gauging of decks, tanks, crane foundations and piping before the next charterer's condition survey.

port.h: The North Sea Canal port: Amsterdam's trades and ships
p: The Port of Amsterdam is an inland port. Ships enter from the North Sea at IJmuiden, pass through the sea locks and sail along the North Sea Canal to basins in Westpoort, the Zaan area and the city itself, with the industrial harbours of Velsen and Beverwijk along the way. The cargo base is distinctive: Amsterdam is a major hub for gasoline blending and storage, a major cocoa port, an importer of agribulk, and a dry bulk port serving the Tata Steel works at IJmuiden. Cruise ships berth at the city passenger terminal and at IJmuiden, but most of the traffic is tankers, bulk carriers, multipurpose ships and offshore vessels rather than deep-sea container ships.

The lock passage shapes how ships use the port. Arrival and departure are planned around lock slots and pilotage, so vessels tend to complete cargo, bunkers and stores in one longer call rather than shifting in and out. Product tankers often wait at the tank terminals or on lay-by berths for blending to finish and for a cargo to be confirmed. Bulk carriers at the steelworks stay until the holds are clear. Offshore vessels and workboats spend whole periods alongside between contracts, and ships that cannot berth at once wait at the anchorages off IJmuiden.

Inspection demand in Amsterdam therefore leans toward trading ships with a specific question rather than full docking programmes. A product tanker owner wants to know the state of cargo and ballast piping before vetting. A bulk carrier operator wants hold frames and hopper plating checked after an ore discharge. A buyer wants pre-purchase readings on a ship that is already idle. Damen Shiprepair Amsterdam's floating docks bring dockings into the mix for short-sea ships, offshore vessels, dredgers and workboats, so pre-docking and in-dock gauging runs here too, usually on smaller tonnage than the deep-sea ships seen at Rotterdam.

facilities.h: Docks, quays and terminals for gauging along the canal
p: Amsterdam ship repair centres on Damen Shiprepair Amsterdam, whose floating docks take short-sea cargo ships, offshore and dredging vessels and workboats. For those ships the team gauges to the TM plan while the yard runs its own survey programme, and the readings feed the steel list for the docking. Larger deep-sea ships that need dry-docking generally go elsewhere in the region, so for them the Amsterdam call is the place for pre-docking gauging rather than for the docking itself.

Alongside berths are where most trading-ship gauging happens. The tank terminals in Westpoort apply their own permit rules: manifold, deck piping and external structure can usually be checked during cargo operations, while tank entry waits for a gas-free certificate. At the dry bulk quays the useful window opens when discharge finishes and holds are swept. The general cargo and agribulk terminals see multipurpose ships and handysize bulkers whose hatch covers, coamings and hold structure can be gauged once hatches are open and holds are empty. Lay-by berths in the basins and quays at IJmuiden suit longer offshore jobs and pre-purchase gauging in Amsterdam, where the ship is idle and the buyer's surveyor can attend.
list: Damen Shiprepair Amsterdam — pre-docking and in-dock gauging for short-sea cargo ships, offshore vessels, dredgers and workboats using its floating docks.
Westpoort tank terminals — manifold, deck piping and pump-room checks on product tankers during loading; cargo-tank gauging once the ship is gas-free.
Tata Steel harbour at IJmuiden — side-shell frames, hopper plating and topside tanks measured on bulk carriers after an iron ore or coal discharge.
Agribulk and general cargo terminals in Westpoort — hatch cover, coaming and hold structure readings on multipurpose ships and handysize bulkers.
IJmuiden quays — deck, tank and piping gauging on offshore support and survey vessels lying alongside between charters.
Anchorages off IJmuiden — limited-scope condition or pre-purchase gauging by launch before the ship enters the locks.

context.h: What shapes inspection demand on the Amsterdam side of the North Sea
p: Amsterdam lies inside the North Sea SOx ECA, and Dutch port state control applies under the Paris MoU. The 0.10% sulphur limit means a deep-sea ship either burns compliant fuel on its way through the IJmuiden approaches or runs a scrubber, and scrubber ships may face local restrictions on open-loop wash-water discharge in port and canal waters, which the agent will confirm for the call. Whichever way the ship complies, overboard discharge lines and their shell connections deserve a look while the system is shut down for the canal passage.

The market around the canal is shaped by the energy transition as much as by trade. The port authority has committed to phasing out coal handling and to growing offshore wind and circular industries, which brings more offshore and project vessels to IJmuiden and the basins. Ships trading on European routes have been inside the EU ETS since 2024 and FuelEU Maritime since 2025, which pushes owners to decide early whether an older product tanker or bulk carrier is worth taking through its next renewal survey. Measured steel condition is the evidence that decision needs, and a long canal call is a practical time to collect it.

jobs.h: UTM jobs we are asked to plan in Amsterdam and IJmuiden
jobs.p: Jobs here are usually scoped around one call rather than a docking. The superintendent knows how long the ship will be alongside, what the terminal permits and which spaces can be opened, and asks for a programme that fits that window. Where a docking at Damen Shiprepair Amsterdam is planned, the work follows the TM plan and the class survey programme instead. Common requests include the following.
list: An LR1 product tanker loading gasoline in Westpoort: deck piping, manifold and ballast tank gauging between parcels, with cargo tanks added during a planned cleaning stop.
A Panamax bulk carrier after an ore discharge at IJmuiden: hold frames, brackets, hopper plating and topside tanks gauged before ballasting, in preparation for the intermediate survey.
An offshore support vessel laid alongside between charters: deck, tank and piping gauging to support the condition survey the next charterer requires.
A short-sea cargo ship entering Damen Shiprepair Amsterdam's floating dock: renewal survey gauging to the TM plan and close-up survey support.
A buyer's pre-purchase inspection of a handysize bulker at an agribulk terminal: hatch coamings, hold structure and ballast tanks gauged once the holds are empty.

logistics: Amsterdam Schiphol is close to the port, so the team can reach Westpoort, the Zaan area or IJmuiden by road soon after landing. Terminal access is ISPS-controlled; the ship's agent submits the technicians' names for gate passes and, for anchorage work, arranges the launch out of IJmuiden. Our technicians travel from India on Schengen visas, which take time to obtain, so tell us the expected call or docking date as early as you can and we will schedule around it, including any change in lock slots.

faqs.q: Can the IJmuiden locks affect when gauging can start?
faqs.a: They can. Arrival and departure through the IJmuiden sea locks are scheduled with pilotage and traffic, and a delayed slot moves the whole call. We plan the team's arrival around the agent's latest berthing estimate and keep in contact as it changes. Once the ship is alongside in the basins, gauging proceeds without further lock constraints until departure.

faqs.q: Can cargo tanks be gauged at a Westpoort tank terminal?
faqs.a: Only when the tanks are clean, ventilated and certified gas-free, and only if the terminal permits tank entry at the berth. Many product tanker jobs in Amsterdam therefore start with deck piping, manifolds, pump-room lines and ballast tanks during loading, and leave cargo tanks for a planned cleaning period, a lay-by berth or the next yard stay.

faqs.q: Which ships dock in Amsterdam itself?
faqs.a: Damen Shiprepair Amsterdam's floating docks take short-sea cargo ships, offshore and dredging vessels and workboats, and we can gauge them in dock to the TM plan. Larger deep-sea ships usually dock elsewhere in the region, so for them Amsterdam is better used for pre-docking gauging that tells the chosen yard how much steel to plan for.

faqs.q: Can you gauge a bulk carrier at the Tata Steel harbour in IJmuiden?
faqs.a: Yes, within the terminal's access rules and the time between end of discharge and departure. Holds need to be swept and safe to enter, with lighting and safe access to frames and brackets, which the ship provides. Topside and hopper ballast tanks can be done too if they can be emptied and ventilated in that window.
